summary: The note describes the Bustamante class, a group of three destroyers built for the Spanish Navy to a British design, completed between 1914 and 1916. The ships served until about 1930–1932, mostly in a training squadron and patrolling Spanish coasts. Compared with contemporary foreign destroyers, the class was considered outclassed, with weak armament and insufficient speed.
one_line: Bustamante-class destroyer: three Spanish Navy destroyers built to a British design in 1914–1916, later considered outclassed.
